message:
The other day, my family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree as we all started sharing our storm prep plans. It was a mix of practical tips and a bit of friendly ribbing about Aunt Edna’s overzealous stockpile of canned beans. 

In times like these, it’s nice to have a reliable resource to guide us through the basics, like how to prepare for floods and what to do before, during, and after a storm. 

I always say it’s better to be a little too prepared than too sorry. What’s your go-to storm prep tip? ☔
